title: Primary Neuron Extraction
author: Yujie Fan
materials: Put female in carcass bag and in freezer

steps.title: Prepare Sterilized Tools
steps.instruction: Heat the dry sterilizer for 30 minutes. Once heated, place scissors and 4 pairs of needle nose forceps inside.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary plating medium and buffers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare plating medium: 50 ml brain phys plating media + 125 ul glutamax + 500 ul Penicillin-Streptomycin + 92.5 of l-glutamine + 1 ml sm1.
Prepare two 15 ml tubes of HBSS 1x by diluting 1 ml of HBSS 10x into 9 ml distilled water.
Prepare papain and HBSS 1x mixture in 1.5 ml tubes (1 tube per 3 cortices). Based on a bottle of 24 mg/ml and 16 units/mg (384 units/ml), use 40 ug papain per 1 ml HBSS 1x to achieve 15 units.
Prepare 'stopping medium' (HBSS 1x + 10% FBS); ensure at least 3 ml per 15 ml tube of 3 cortices is available.

steps.title: Euthanize Mouse and Prepare for Dissection
steps.instruction: Euthanize the female mouse and prepare the workspace for sterile extraction.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize a female mouse at day 17 of pregnancy using a CO2 bubble for approximately 5 minutes until breathing stops.
Place the AT cooling Core in a container.
Prepare a slide box with paper towels, place the mouse on her back, and spray thoroughly with 70% Ethanol.
Fill three sterile 100mm plates with HBSS 1X from the fridge and place one on the cooling core.

steps.title: Extract Embryos
steps.instruction: Carefully remove embryos from the uterus.

substeps.instruction: Lift the skin with sterile forceps and use scissors to cut low and upward to expose embryos.
Lift the sac and snip out the uterus, avoiding organ nicks (5 embryos are sufficient for two 24-well plates).
Place embryos, still in the uterus, into the cooled HBSS 1x media.
Use two forceps to remove embryos from the sac and place them in the HBSS 1X dish.

steps.title: Dissect Brains and Isolate Hippocampus
steps.instruction: Isolate the hippocampal regions from the embryos.

substeps.instruction: Position the embryo on its back and pin behind the head with forceps.
Peel back the skin and skull; place forceps under the cerebellum and lift up and forward to remove the brain from the skull.
Move the embryo out of solution into the HBSS 1x dish and repeat for all embryos.
Hold the cerebellum with forceps, lift and snip off each cortical lobe (the hippocampus will come off with the cortex). Move the remaining brain to HBSS 1x and repeat.
Stabilize the cortex with one pair of forceps and gently tear off the meninges with another pair.
Flip the cortex over and remove the hippocampus.

steps.title: Digest Hippocampal Tissue
steps.instruction: Process the hippocampal sections using papain for dissociation.

substeps.instruction: Quarter each hippocampus and transfer sections to a 15ml falcon tube using a cut 1ml pipette tip.
Remove as much HBSS from the tube as possible before moving to the TC.
Add 1ml papain/HBSS mixture to each 15 ml falcon tube.
Place tubes in a water bath for 15 minutes total, shaking the tubes at the 7.5-minute mark.
Remove digested sections from the incubator; let pieces settle, then use a bulb and glass pipette to remove the solution, leaving 1ml behind.

steps.title: Wash and Dissociate Neurons
steps.instruction: Rinse the tissue and mechanically dissociate the neurons.

substeps.instruction: Rinse pieces once by adding 5ml HBSS 1X + 10% FBS, wait 20 seconds, and remove most of the solution. Repeat this wash step once more.
Let larger pieces settle and transfer the supernatant to a new 15ml Falcon tube (alternatively, transfer the big pieces to a new tube).
Add 3ml HBSS 1X and dissociate by pipetting gently 10 times with a glass pipette; transfer the supernatant (containing dissociated neurons) to a new tube.

Perform a final dissociation by adding 2ml HBSS 1X to the remaining hippocampal pieces, pipette up and down 5 times, and transfer the supernatant to the neuron tube (total volume roughly 6ml). Remove any remaining large pieces.

steps.title: Collect and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Concentrate the cells and resuspend them in plating media.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells for 5 minutes at 1000rpm at room temperature.
While spinning, warm complete media in a 37°C water bath.
Remove the supernatant from the pelleted cells.
Add 8ml of warmed complete brain phys media and gently resuspend by pipetting up and down 6 times.

steps.title: Plate and Maintain Culture
steps.instruction: Prepare plates and maintain the neuron culture.

substeps.instruction: Coat the required number of plates with Poly-L-Ornithine and incubate for 1 hour at 37°C.
Perform a half to full medium change on cell culture dishes every 3 days.
